description: V0.7b characterization (docs/benchmark/v07b-dev/PLAN.md): suite dreamteam-dev version 3, the five practices with a $50,000 credit line at 10% (-credit) and with none (-nocredit), each with the funding rule; noop, greedy and conservative-v2; 90 days; paired with version 2's runs on the same practice, seed and policy.
